Public brand asset provenance — source-only refinement

Instagram: official Meta Instagram brand resources
https://www.meta.com/brand/resources/instagram/instagram-brand/
Pack: IG_brand_asset_pack_2023.zip, linked by the official page.
instagram-logo.svg: 01 Static Glyph/03 Black Glyph/Instagram_Glyph_Black.svg
instagram-logo-white.svg: 01 Static Glyph/02 White Glyph/Instagram_Glyph_White.svg
Both are original vector files. The official gradient SVG embeds raster artwork
and was deliberately not used. Black glyph is displayed on the same neutral
icon canvas as Telegram and Discord. Meta trademark/brand guidelines apply.

DePay: https://depay.com/brand
Original: https://depay.com/brand/DePay%20Wordmark.svg
All 23 paths, gradients and brand geometry preserved. The transparent artboard
was reduced to viewBox 222.91 124.93 804.51 247.68, including the full white
circle and complete wordmark; no artwork traced, cropped or recolored.
This replaces the former SVG that contained an embedded raster image.
DePay trademark/brand guidelines apply.

Vela by LuxAlgo (not the unrelated Vela Exchange):
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LuxAlgo/Vela/57d011ab796c541cbb9e1282722ad6cd521c8f55/src/renderers/native/chrome/vela-logos.ts
The VELA_MARK_SVG Morning Star mark is taken from upstream's identity-kit
paths with its original viewBox; currentColor is resolved to native black
on the common neutral logo canvas. See Vela-Apache-2.0.txt and Vela-NOTICE.txt.

TradingView: tradingview-mark.svg uses the unchanged official mark path from
the existing tradingview-logo.svg (last path), with a tight mark-only viewBox.
https://www.tradingview.com/branding/
See TradingView-logo-LICENSE.txt. The existing wordmark asset is preserved.
Gains and Render: existing official vector files and colors remain unchanged.
https://gains.trade/  https://render.com/brand

Liara: official logo, unchanged (paths, gradients and viewBox as published)
https://liara.ir/assets/images/liara-logo.svg  https://liara.ir
Liara trademark/brand guidelines apply.

Bitpin: official logo, unchanged (single path, #00d890 fill, viewBox as published)
https://bitpin.ir/assets/logo/bitpin.svg  https://bitpin.ir
Displayed as a market-data credit only; it does not indicate a commercial
agreement or a live integration status. Bitpin trademark/brand guidelines apply.

All seven footer service logos (Gains, Vela, TradingView, DePay, Render, Liara,
Bitpin) use one neutral wrapper; no CSS color filters.
Community destinations remain owner-configured. No Telegram, Discord or
Instagram destination ownership is verified by these assets or URL validators.

Hyperliquid: official vector mark embedded in https://hyperliquid.xyz
(inline SVG "Layer_1", viewBox 0 0 856 200, captured 2026-11-12). The mark
path (first path) is preserved unchanged; the wordmark paths are omitted.
hyperliquid-mark.svg: the mark alone in Hyperliquid's mint #97FCE4 (platform
motion orb). hyperliquid-logo.svg: the same mark on Hyperliquid's dark teal
#072723 rounded square, as in its app icon, so it reads on light and dark
footers (footer service listing). Shown as a visual provider listing only; it does
not indicate an active trading, liquidity or data integration.
Hyperliquid trademark/brand guidelines apply.

GMX: official brand repository https://github.com/gmx-io/gmx-assets
Original: GMX-Assets/SVG/GMX_LOGO ONLY.svg. Path and gradient preserved;
the transparent artboard, clip path and nested transforms are flattened into
one equivalent translate with a tight viewBox. No artwork traced or recolored.
GMX trademark/brand guidelines apply.
